statement: Lb asks that the canonical localization Cat -> Cat[W^{-1}] preserve finite coproducts, including the empty coproduct.
repair: It follows from L5: W is stable under componentwise coproducts over discrete bases; the coproduct/diagonal adjunction descends to localization. The initial-object adjunction handles the empty case.
references: Cisinski2004Minimal, Proposition 1.1.5; Commentary, Finite products and sums already descend

statement: Lc asks that the canonical localization Cat -> Cat[W^{-1}] preserve finite products, including the empty product.
repair: L5 makes u x id_C a weak equivalence for every u in W and every C. The diagonal/product adjunction descends to localization; the terminal-object adjunction handles the empty case.
references: Cisinski2004Minimal, Proposition 1.1.7; Commentary, Finite products and sums already descend

statement: The footnote suggests obtaining the finite product and coproduct assertions from a Quillen model structure on (Cat,W).
gap_or_error: A generic model-category argument directly gives derived products and coproducts; identifying these with the ordinary categorical ones requires their homotopy invariance.
repair: Under the standing localizer axioms this required invariance follows directly from L5, so the conclusion is correct and the Quillen hypothesis is unnecessary.
references: Commentary, Finite products and sums already descend
notes: No counterexample to the conclusion under the standing assumptions is alleged. The qualification concerns the abbreviated justification, not an error in the retained conclusion.

statement: Do Lb and Lc hold for every W_D under consideration, and what are their concrete conditions on W?
repair: Yes under L1-L5, already verified for W_D here. Componentwise coproduct stability and stability under products with arbitrary fixed categories make both ordinary adjunctions descend; the commentary gives the proof.
notes: Source-open only; the present status is affirmative, with no accessibility assumption needed for this categorical argument in an adequate universe.

statement: Ld: u in W_D implies u^op in W_D.
repair: Naturality of the twisted-arrow span A <- T(A) -> A^op, whose two projections are Grothendieck fibrations with final-object fibres, gives the assertion from L5 and saturation. Applying it twice gives the converse.
references: Chapter I, Corollary 2, ms. p. 75; Cisinski2006, Sorites 3.3.8(7); Commentary, Completing the reduction to three axioms
